title: Right Direction
story:
A woman was hiking to a mountain lake.

She followed the trail markers.

At first, the path was easy.

“Stay left.”

“Cross the bridge.”

After a while, she thought she saw a shortcut.

She ignored the next marker.

She stepped off the trail.

Soon, she was lost.

The trees all looked the same.

She felt anxious.

Then she noticed a blue mark on a tree nearby.

It was a trail marker.

It did not shame her.

It did not disappear because she wandered.

It simply pointed the way back.

This time, she chose to follow it.

Step by step, the markers led her forward.

Finally, she reached the lake.

In life, we often think we know a better way.

We try our own shortcuts.

But God has already marked the path.

Even when we wander,

He shows us the way back.

When we follow Him,

He leads us where we need to be.
life_lesson:
God’s guidance does not stop when you make a mistake.

No matter how far you wander, He will lead you back.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for guiding me in my life.

Forgive me for the times I choose my own way.

When I wander, help me to see Your direction.

Give me the humility to follow Your path.

Lead me safely to where I need to be.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you been trying to take your own shortcut?

Are you willing to return to God's path?

What step can you take today to follow His guidance?
verse:
I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go.
I will counsel you with My loving eye on you.
